summary: Centerspace filed an 8-K disclosing a September 22, 2026 amendment to its September 8, 2026 merger agreement with Independence Realty Trust. The amendment adds IRT Merger Sub as a party and elects the previously contemplated alternative structure, under which Centerspace will merge into IRT Merger Sub, with IRT Merger Sub surviving, rather than the reverse. No price, exchange ratio, premium, or closing date is stated in the excerpt. IRT waived any representation inaccuracy caused solely by the structural change. IRT will file a Form S-4 joint proxy/prospectus; watch SEC review timing, shareholder votes, and any revised deal terms.
